CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_ReservacionExtra_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@Reservacion_Id AS INT = 0, 
@ConceptoFacturable_Id AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @ReservacionExtraFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		ReservacionExtra_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @ReservacionExtraFilter (ReservacionExtra_Id)
		SELECT 
			[ReservacionExtra].Id
		FROM [dbo].[ReservacionExtra]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[ReservacionExtra].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @ReservacionExtraFilter (ReservacionExtra_Id)
		SELECT 
			[ReservacionExtra].Id
		FROM [dbo].[ReservacionExtra]
		WHERE
			 [ReservacionExtra].[Activo] = 1 AND
         (([ReservacionExtra].[Reservacion_Id] = @Reservacion_Id) OR (@Reservacion_Id = 0)) AND
         (([ReservacionExtra].[ConceptoFacturable_Id] = @ConceptoFacturable_Id) OR (@ConceptoFacturable_Id = 0))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[ReservacionExtra].[Id],
		[ReservacionExtra].[Reservacion_Id],
		[ReservacionExtra].[ConceptoFacturable_Id],
		[ReservacionExtra].[Cantidad],
		[ReservacionExtra].[Activo],
		[ReservacionExtra].[FechaDesactivacion],
		[ReservacionExtra].[DesactivadoPor],
		[Reservacion].[Titulo] AS [ReservacionTitulo],
		[Reservacion].[Descripcion] AS [ReservacionDescripcion],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[Concepto] AS [ConceptoFacturableConcepto],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[Descripcion] AS [ConceptoFacturableDescripcion],
		[ReservacionExtra].[FechaCreacion],
		[ReservacionExtra].[CreadoPor],
		[ReservacionExtra].[FechaModificacion],
		[ReservacionExtra].[ModificadoPor]
	FROM @ReservacionExtraFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[ReservacionExtra] 
			ON [ReservacionExtra].[Id] = filter.[ReservacionExtra_Id] 
			

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Reservacion]
		ON [dbo].[ReservacionExtra].[Reservacion_Id] = [dbo].[Reservacion].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[ConceptoFacturable]
		ON [dbo].[ReservacionExtra].[ConceptoFacturable_Id] = [dbo].[ConceptoFacturable].[Id] 

 
END
